voice.policy: SAY in Ukrainian; READ short English chunks; correct mistakes immediately; answers in English.

steps.say: Зміни: «Olga is Beth’s aunt». Хто Бет для Олги?
Скажи правду: 'I ___ got a sister.' Англійською.
Зміни на 'she': 'We’ve got a big family.'
steps.model: Модель: "She’s got a big family." Повтори.
expect: She has got a big family.

steps.model: Модель: "They haven’t got any sisters." Повтори.
expect: They have not got any sisters.

steps.say: Коротка відповідь: 'Have you got a pet?'

blocks.title: have got — питання та короткі відповіді

steps.model: Модель: "Has he got blue eyes?" Повтори.
Модель: "Has she got a sister?" Повтори.

steps.say: Коротко відповідай: 'Has she got a sister?'
Постав: 'How many … has … got?' для Emma — brothers and sisters.
steps.model: Модель: "How many brothers and sisters has Emma got?" Повтори.
expect: How many brothers and sisters has Emma got?

steps.say: Скажи англійською: the brother of Beth.
Скажи англійською: the name of your dad.
Скажи англійською: the friends of my sisters (множина).
steps.model: Модель: "My sisters’ friends are nice." Повтори.

steps.say: Перефразуй: the bike of Ben → з ’s.
Речення: she / long blonde hair. Англійською.
steps.model: Модель: "She’s got long blonde hair." Повтори.

steps.say: Опиши: he / tall + glasses. Два речення.
steps.model: Модель: "He is tall. He’s got glasses." Повтори.
expect: He is tall. He’s got glasses.

steps.model: Модель: "We’ve got short brown hair." Повтори.
expect: We have got short brown hair.

steps.say: Зараз прочитаю англійський текст. Слухай уважно.
steps.hint: Підказка: зверни увагу на імена й ролі.

steps.read: Ysabella Wallenda-Cortes is from a circus family. She is a young trapeze artist. Her parents, Robinson and Alida, work in the circus too. She has two brothers, Lucas and Tomas. They help the family and learn new skills.

steps.say: Про що уривок 1? Скажи коротко англійською.
steps.model: Модель: "It’s about a circus family." Повтори.
expect: It is about a circus family.

steps.read: Ysabella’s uncle Alex is her dad’s brother. Her aunt Aurelia is her mum’s sister. Aurelia is a teacher. Her grandparents, Olinka and Tino, are part of the circus too.

steps.say: Скажи англійською: Is Alex her dad’s brother?

steps.read: Olinka doesn’t perform now. Tino is in his sixties, but he is still a tightrope walker. Lucas and Tomas haven’t got jobs in the circus yet.

steps.say: True or False: Olinka performs now.
Скажи англійською: What is Tino’s job?
steps.model: Модель: "He is a tightrope walker." Повтори.

steps.say: Зараз прочитаю англійський текст. Слухай уважно.

steps.read: Twins Day is a festival in Pleucadeuc, France, on 15th August. Twins, triplets and quadruplets come from many countries. Families wear the same clothes and hairstyles. There are fun activities like face painting, music and games.

steps.say: Що таке Twins Day? Відповідай англійською.
steps.model: Модель: "A festival for twins in France." Повтори.
expect: A festival for twins in France.

steps.read: Many people make new friends and take photos. It is the biggest twins meeting in Europe, and it happens every year on the same date.

steps.say: True or False: Twins Day is on 15th August.

steps.model: Модель: "Hey, Evan. How are things?" Повтори.
Модель: "OK, thanks. See you later." Повтори.

steps.say: Рольова: 'Hi! Have you got any new friends?'
steps.model: Модель: "Yes, I have. I’ve got a new friend." Повтори.

steps.say: Постав запитання: чи в нього блакитні очі.
steps.model: Модель: "Has he got blue eyes?" Повтори.

steps.say: Скажи: твій вік, сім’я, тварини, друг. Англійською.
steps.model: Модель: "I’m eleven. I’ve got a big family." Повтори.

steps.say: Частина 2: розкажи про сім’ю з 'have got'.

steps.model: Модель: "I’ve got a dog. I like football." Повтори.
Модель: "Have you got a pet? Do you play games? See you!" Повтори.
Модель: "They haven’t got any cousins." Повтори.
Модель: "Has he got green eyes?" Повтори.
Модель: "She’s got long blonde hair." Повтори.

steps.say: True or False: Olinka performs now.

steps.model: Модель: "He is a tightrope walker." Повтори.

steps.say: Питай: How many brothers and sisters has she got?
steps.model: Модель: "How many brothers and sisters has she got?" Повтори.
expect: How many brothers and sisters has she got?

steps.say: Рольова: запитай мене про мого нового друга (2 питання).
steps.hint: Підказка: 'Have you got…? What’s his name?'
steps.model: Модель: "Have you got a new friend? What’s his name?" Повтори.

steps.say: Обери: True or False — Twins Day is in France.
Обери: True or False — Twins Day is on 15th August.
Вимов коротко: про що Twins Day?
steps.model: Модель: "A festival for twins in France." Повтори.
expect: A festival for twins in France.

steps.say: Скажи три факти: 'have got', слово родини, опис.
steps.model: Модель: "I’ve got a cat. My cousin is Ben. He’s got brown eyes." Повтори.
